The NFL's first-ever game in Rio de Janeiro delivered exactly what fans wanted. Ravens vs. Cowboys was a back-and-forth battle from start to finish, with momentum swinging all night long before Baltimore escaped Brazil with a dramatic 34-31 victory. Big plays, late-game drama, and a packed Maracana Stadium made this feel like a playoff game in September. Of course, it wouldn't be an NFL thriller without controversy. Fans from both sides were left frustrated by several officiating decisions throughout the game, and social media was buzzing about the whistles long after the final snap. Despite the chaos, Lamar Jackson and the Ravens found a way to finish the job, while Dallas was left wondering what could have been after letting another close game slip away... #brazil #nflfootball #cowboys #ravens #lamarjackson
